run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate bulk slab objects and write vasp input files
precompute_slabs_for_bulk: precompute slabs for a given bulk index and save them to the precomputed directory
write_surface_vasp_inputs: write vasp input files and metadata for a specified slab surface
generate_random_placements: generate random adsorbate placements on a slab surface with configurable rotation modes
generate_heuristic_placements: generate heuristic adsorbate placements on a slab surface with augmentation options
